notes.title: Tokyo Games Show 2024
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce our participation in the Tokyo Games Show 2024 for the second time!

And on this occasion, we are giving a limited time 40% discount on our game in Steam Store!

Those who are in TGS, pay us a visit at booth 10-C07. We got a surprise for you!

notes.title: Major Language Addon
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We are happy to announce that we have added 7 more languages for you to enjoy the experience in Sheba!

Languages Added:
[list]
[*] Arabic
[*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] Turkish
[*] Russian
[/list]


Enjoy your time!

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0.6.8
notes.notes:
Date: 6th May 2024 (UTC)
Version: 1.0.6.8

Hot Fix Updates:
[olist]
[*] Fixed | Moving Platforms sometimes stops moving even after switching them on.
[*] Fixed | Some areas player could not backtrack from in Timna City.
[*] Fixed | Some Interaction Instructions were not visible.
[*] Fixed | Placing a Crystal in the Pillar in Timna City using the controller was looping the player to the Inventory Menu.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0.6.7
notes.notes:
Date: 2nd May 2024 (UTC)
Version: 1.0.6.7

Hot Fix Updates:
[olist]
[*] Fixed | Switches, Moving Doors, and Rotating Platforms were not loading in the proper position.
[*] Change | Item shortcuts in the HUD now does not remove and replenish automatically.
[*] Change | Added instructions for Dash ability once it is learned. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0.6.6
notes.notes:
Date: 25th April 2024 (UTC)
Version: 1.0.6.6

Hot Fix Updates:
[olist]
[*] Fixed | Enemy debuff ticks were updating player HUD.
[*] Fixed | Player HP and MP could sometimes jump below zero.
[*] Change | Player now will respawn to last save file after death.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0.6.5
notes.notes:
Date: 18th April 2024 (UTC)
Version: 1.0.6.5

Hot Fix changes:
[olist]
[*] Enhanced the camera path movement while triggering a switch.
[*] Fixed bug where some switch triggers were not saving properly.
[*] Fixed bug while changing switch trigger state (on/off) and their VFX.
[*] Fixed bug where player debuffs status where not loading properly.
[*] Fixed bug where enemy debuffs showed up in the player's HUD.
[*] Fixed bug where in-game menu tabs where not opening when clicked using the mouse.
[*] Fixed bug where Skill Scrolls were not useable after loading a game.
[*] Fixed bug where selling a gem at the shop results in selling the first gem in the list.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0.6.4
notes.notes:
Date: 13th April 2024 (UTC)
Version: 1.0.6.4

Hot Fix changes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed bug where Steam Achievements was not connecting properly.
[*] Fixed bug where player can die from poison while in cutscene.
[*] Fixed Doors, Switches, and triggers SFX.
[*] Fixed UI bug where clicking left/right arrows does not work for Auto Skip Dialogue option in Gameplay Settings.
[*] Camera now moves to the activated device to show the location.
[*] Moving Platforms on/off indications are now more obvious.
[*] Updated jump SFX to be less annoying.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.6.3
notes.notes:
Date: 9th April 2024 (UTC)
Version: 1.0.6.3

Based on your feedback, we noticed that people got stuck in couple of situations so we have decide to fix things. 

Hot Fix changes:
[list]
[*] Added a Healing Option based on missing health in the save points.
[*] A hint has been provided in Ma'rib to locate the Prince of Thieves.
[/list]

notes.title: Available Now! (Steam Deck Compatible)
notes.notes:
🚀 Exciting News! 🚀

We're thrilled to announce the launch of the game.
🎉 You can try it on your Steam deck as well! 🎉

This milestone is not just a testament to our team's hard work and dedication, but also to the incredible support from our community, partners, and everyone who believed in us.

A heartfelt thank you to each and every one of you. Your encouragement and feedback have been the guiding lights on this journey.

This is our Roadmap for the upcoming contents

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1682820/extras/Sheba_Timeline.png[/img]

Let's celebrate this new chapter together. 🎉

notes.title: Metroidvania Fusion Participation
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that we are participating in Steam's much-anticipated "Metroidvania Fusion" event! 

This special occasion is dedicated to celebrating the rich, explorative, and intricate world of Metroidvania games.

Our [b]demo[/b] will be [b]available[/b] during the event:
From the [b]4th of March Till the 11th of March 10 AM (PST)[/b]
